findings.problem: The client-side terminal set that closes the first-run progress UI is described prose-only ('closes on a terminal state') rather than naming the three terminal literals (ready/corrupt/error) at the UI layer the way the supervisor stop condition does. Non-blocking because ModelDownloadState is a shared enum and the supervisor stop condition already enumerates the terminal set.
findings.fix: In §B.11 state that the progress UI treats ready|corrupt|error as terminal (same set as the supervisor stop condition) and renders the final state, then closes/offers retry.
